The COST Action **Open Palaeoecological Data** (PalaeOpen) welcomes researchers and practitioners interested in contributing to and benefiting from our collaborative efforts. Members can participate in workshops and events and collaborate on research projects that explore ecosystem responses to climate and land-use changes over decades to millennia.

## How to join

Apply to join one or more PalaeOpen Working Groups through the COST e-Services platform. Membership is open to individuals from COST member countries and approved partner countries.

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width=25%}
:::

::: {.column width=50%}

We use [Zulip](https://zulip.com/) as our main communication platform. New PalaeOpen members should receive an email invitation to the workspace within one to two weeks. If you have questions about the workspace, including joining or creating channels, contact your Working Group leader or co-leader listed on the [Core Group](coregroup.qmd) page.
